Cycle R-20260816T023958. Executed batch [T-048, T-052, T-046]; all three done with evidence, gates green (zig build 0, just test 0, just swift-test 0, 578 cases — 569 before, +7 ProjectNoteUndoTests, +2 ProjectPriorityResetTests). Every implementation Todo of the current layer is now done except the docs (T-053) and the final verification (T-054).
T-048: new list_projects action wired through Binding.zig (enum + .surface scope), command.zig (no palette), Surface.zig dispatch, apprt/action.zig (variant + C Key), include/xghostty.h (XGHOSTTY_ACTION_LIST_PROJECTS appended last for C ABI order), XGhostty.App.swift (case + listProjects gated on canBeginProjectList), ghosttyListProjects notification, BaseTerminalController observer. Cmd+L now opens the project list and choose_project_layout moved to Cmd+Opt+L. New macos/Sources/Features/Projects/ProjectListOverlay.swift reuses ProjectHideSelector's keyboard mechanics. HiddenProjectShelf.swift deleted along with onShowProject/showProject delegate plumbing (BaseTerminalController.showProject stays for the show_project action). Controller owns Space (toggleProjectListVisibility, per-toggle undo, no focus move), Enter (focusProjectListRow) and Escape (closeProjectList, which returns focus to the project focused AFTER the session's toggles).
T-052: Workday.nextBoundary(after:calendar:) added to the model; BaseTerminalController installs the triggers at the end of init (immediate check + boundary Timer on RunLoop .common, rescheduled per firing + NSApplication.didBecomeActive + NSWorkspace.didWake), deinit invalidates and detaches.
T-046: new macos/Sources/Features/Projects/NoteEditHistory.swift (session-scoped, note-body-only undo/redo, 0.75 s typing coalescing, any larger change its own step) driven from ProjectNoteEditor's existing overlay keyDown monitor; deliberately not the window's NSUndoManager, which holds the project layer's undo entries.
R-015 (non-blocking) records this batch's four Essence-silent interpretations for confirmation at the on-device checks. R-014 (previous cycle) does the same for remote split.
next_actions: Next batch: T-053 (docs) then T-054 (final verification) — the last two atlas-builder Todos of this layer.
